title: Concept: Deprecated schema fields disclosed
description: A deprecated field with its deprecation reason in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The reason text usually names the replacement and the migration date, which tells an attacker which old field is still wired to the legacy code path.
applicability: Deployments that render a deprecated field with its deprecation reason into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The reason text usually names the replacement and the migration date, which tells an attacker which old field is still wired to the legacy code path.
